job_title: Senior Director, Artificial Intelligence IT Architecture- Remote
job_description:
This Sr. Director, Artificial Intelligence Architecture is responsible for defining and evangelizing the technical strategy, vision, development and implementation of AI technology platforms for GuideWell. As a strategic operational and innovation partner, this role is challenged with defining artificial intelligence solutions to address complex business challenges, then work with organization execution teams to implement and support those solutions. The role will work to demonstrate and articulate best-in-class capabilities and practices to streamline, standardize and optimize the technology platform to achieve stability, security and scalability while ensuring a positive user experience. Will lead a team responsible for facilitating adoption of AI and LLM models to solve business and technical problems. This role will support future innovation and business transformation needs with focus on revenue growth, consumer experience and data-based insights.

What are the key responsibilities:
• Coordinate with execution teams to add AI capabilities to existing applications, improve operational efficiency and drive innovation within our organization of a multiyear AI technology roadmap
• Architect services that leverage AI and LLM models and frameworks to solve business problems and improve performance across various domains, and support adoption of those models and frameworks across the enterprise
• Work collaboratively to address cross-domain technology issues associated with AI
• Stay abreast of new disruptive and innovative technologies and manage and direct processes and R&D to meet the needs of our AI strategy. Demonstrate a commitment to innovative process and technology improvements in AI
• Participate in strategy and direction setting process and collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and apply AI technology solutions
• Provides leadership oversight to help the company and clients understand how to integrate AI capabilities to provide solutions that benefit our customers
• Work with cross-functional teams in identifying and prioritizing key areas of a partner’s business where AI solutions can drive significant business benefit
• Leads the function with a “risk-aware” mindset ensuring to anticipate unintended consequences of recommendations and decision making

What is Required:
• 6+ years’ work experience in progressively responsible experience managing large IT operational teams, during which both professional and management capabilities have been clearly demonstrated
• 5+ years direct supervisory/management experience, with demonstrated successful leading technical team members and cross functional teams
• Previous experience in applying AI to practical and comprehensive technology solutions and as an IT engineer, data scientist, or similar role, with a focus on developing and implementing AI solutions
• Demonstrated ability to be an innovative leader with respected business knowledge leveraging experience to apply technology solutions to business problems through large scale implementations of new systems and technologies
• Strong orientation towards driving the success of the client experience and demonstrated strength of managing client expectations
• Knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical modeling, and IT techniques and experience applying them to meet real-world problems
• Experience leading functional project teams in implementing projects of a complex nature
• Demonstrated critical thinking and planning at a strategic, global level with ability to translate strategic plans into specific objectives, and to create and execute project plans to achieve objectives
• Exceptional communication skills (written and verbal); leading and presenting complex materials for various audiences including the wide range of stakeholders, physicians, clinicians, and business operations
• Deep understanding of the interdependent relationship between infrastructure, information security and the applications/services they enable as well as the criticality of maintaining strong connections between the respective teams within IT
• Success in being able to see the "big picture" across such areas as private and public hosted infrastructure and services, identity management, security, telecommunications, enterprise storage and big data opportunities, end user experience, and training/education
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex data sets and derive actional insights. Demonstrated effective change management skills
• Knowledge of applicable laws and regulations as they relate to technology issues is important.
• Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience

What is Preferred:
• Master’s degree in Computer or Data Science, Information Technology
• Certifications in networking and security or enterprise architecture (Cisco, Microsoft, GIAC,CISSP)
• Advanced professional certifications in CHIME, ACHE, ACGME and other professional associations

What We Offer:
As a Florida Blue employee, you will thrive in our Be Well, Work Well, GuideWell culture where being well as an individual, and working well as a team, are both important in serving our members and communities.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:
• Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
• Income protection benefits: life insurance, Short- and long-term disability programs;
• Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
• Retirement Savings Plan includes employer contribution and employer match;
• Paid time off, volunteer time off, and 11 holidays
• Additional voluntary benefits available; and
• A comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Annualized Salary Range: $156,000 - $253,500

Typical Annualized Hiring Range: $156,000 - $195,000

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Protected Veteran/Disabled Employer committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable culture for our employees and communities.

The mission of the unit is to accelerate innovation around people and organizational analytics through building a robust partnership ecosystem with leading-edge People Analytics players as well as developing new capabilities/offerings with BCG’s advanced analytics units, GAMMA. You will work with POPX innovation director and his global team in building/managing partner relationships, incubating new analytical offerings, providing functional expertise and insights, and working together with BCG case and proposal teams to deliver customized analytics and expert advisory on the people & organizational analytics.

In addition, you will support with guidance from senior colleagues, your topic/sector in developing intellectual property & knowledge assets and managing content on internal BCG websites, ensuring availability of latest, high-quality content. You will also support business development and go-to-market efforts of the people & organizational analytics areas, as opportunities arise, contributing research and analysis to marketing efforts.

BCG's People & Organization Practice (POP) is a premiere consulting organization offering advisory and transformation services with a clear focus on business value creation through People and Organization. BCG's POP expertise is concentrated in four critical areas: Organization Design, People Strategy, Change Management, and Agile. Our clients are senior business and functional executives who value BCG's strategic, fact-based, and impact-oriented approach supported by highly experienced senior expert teams and rich benchmarking databases and analytical capability.
YOU'RE GOOD AT
• Applying topic/sector expertise when contributing to building and deploying a product/tool/data/analytics, taking different client contexts into account
• Working collaboratively and effectively in a group dynamic often virtual, proficient in agile ways of working
• Communicating with senior stakeholders, being credible and proactive
• Framing, structuring, and sharing intellectual property, with the ability to write clearly and concisely
• Working creatively and analytically in a time-limited, problem-solving environment
• Flexibility and bring a curious and creative mindset, open for new things and able to propose innovative ideas
• Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity

YOU BRING (EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS)
• Master's degree relevant to sector/topic; 1+ year of relevant work experience in sector/topic preferred
• Or Bachelor's degree, with strict minimum of 2+ years of relevant work experience in people and organizational analytics
• Expertise in relevant business, people and organizational analytics (Advanced Excel skills, Alteryx/Python preferable)
• Fluency in English
• Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Our knowledge and research specialists collaborate with global colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our clients. Our team is made up of a diverse pool of knowledge and research positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative research careers.

About the role

Analyst will create Gartner research, provide related advice to clients and support the sales force in new sales and client retention. The research provides insight and actionable advice to clients in the area of AI, GenAI, Machine Learning (ML) and Data Science. This includes writing about, presenting and advising organizations on AI technologies, governance, best practices, market trends and vendors and their solutions.

Expertise in:
• AI/ML model development, deployment and management.
• AI Application development and project management
• Data and Analytics & AI Programs and Practices
• Use implications of AI
• AI Vendor solution comparisons

What you will do
• Identify critical questions facing Gartner clients and craft appropriate advice and methods to address them. Provide in-depth analysis based on needs determined by Gartner topic leaders, client input, collaboration with other Gartner analysts and personal experience in the areas of AI, GenAI, Machine Learning and Data Science to advise CDAOs and their teams. Specific areas of focus will include strategy, best practices, technologies, use cases, market trends and vendors.
• Applicable experience in an industry discipline and deep knowledge of the CDAO, Head of Analytics and AI responsibilities or related business role as well as a market and industry perspective. This includes an understanding of both technology and business needs including user strategies in specific areas and markets.
• Cover the specified areas as well as applicable adjacent areas as needed, while maintaining a view across a broad spectrum of related topics to produce innovative, thought-leading, impactful, fact-based research for CDAOs and their teams.
• Lead a body of research and be recognized in the industry as a subject matter expert.
• Create and deliver high value presentations and other materials.
• Assist the Sales organization in selling and retention on topics covered by the Analyst's team.
• Provide high quality and timely research peer review. Provide mentorship and support team members.
• Actively participate in or lead research projects as needed and collaborate effectively with peers.

What you will need
• Bachelor's degree in related field; advanced degree preferred and/or relevant qualifications and/or experience.
• 10+ years of experience within the technology field, specifically AI/ML model development, deployment, and management
• Deep knowledge of the CDAO, Head of Analytics and AI responsibilities or related business role as well as a market and industry perspective.
• Technology and business knowledge of end-user best practices, strategies, AI/ML market, vendors, and products.
• Articulate and succinct communication skills, the ability to explain complex ideas effectively.
• The ability to communicate credibly and effectively with executive audiences (executive presence) and presentation skills.
• Exceptional analytical skills: ability to apply conceptual models, recognize patterns and draw and defend conclusions. Ability to think abstractly and strategically is a must.
• Strong project planning and management skills.
• Ability to take direction and be self-directed in executing against plans.
• Strong collaboration ethos, influencing and leadership skills.
• A motivated, creative individual who can grow research depth and skills and help others to do the same.

The Company

Hitachi drives Social Innovation Business, creating a sustainable society through the use of data and technology. We solve customers' and society's challenges with Lumada solutions leveraging IT, OT (Operational Technology) and products. Hitachi operates under the business structure of "Digital Systems & Services" - supporting our customers' digital transformation; "Green Energy & Mobility" - contributing to a decarbonized society through energy and railway systems, and "Connective Industries" - connecting products through digital technology to provide solutions in various industries. Driven by Digital, Green, and Innovation, we aim for growth through co-creation with our customers. The company's consolidated revenues for fiscal year 2022 (ended March 31, 2023) totaled 10,881.1 billion yen, with 696 consolidated subsidiaries and approximately 320,000 employees worldwide. For more information on Hitachi, please visit the company's website athttps://www.hitachi.com.

Summary

Hitachi America, Ltd. (http://www.hitachi-america.us/) has openings for Interns in the IT Innovation and AI Solutions located in Silicon Valley. The mission of this team is to help create new and innovative solutions that utilize artificial intelligence and advanced analytics of the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT). The IT innovation team focuses on research, technology innovation, proof-of-concept activities, technical marketing and business development for novel AI solutions, leveraging Hitachi's technologies, reinforcing Hitachi's messaging around big data, and establishing Hitachi as a leader in Industrial AI.

We are seeking talented and ambitious college students to join our dynamic team as Machine Learning Engineering Interns. As an ML Engineering Intern, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge machine learning projects, collaborate with experienced professionals, and gain valuable hands-on experience in the field of artificial intelligence and data science. The successful candidates will have an opportunity to solve challenging real-world problems, and to contribute solutions that will benefit society. You will work in a team environment with significant interaction with researchers.

Qualifications:
• Candidate in progress for their Masters degree in Computer Science or related fields. (PhD preferred)
• A background and research experience in deep learning, reinforcement learning and other machine learning algorithms and their applications. Knowledge of time series analysis techniques is a plus.
• Good programming skills and knowledge of data science tools and libraries in Python or R and experience with Deep Learning frameworks such as TensorFlow. Knowledge of big data platforms is a plus.
• A record of publications in top machine learning or data mining conferences or journals
• In addition, the successful candidate will possess the following behavioral characteristics:
• Must have strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
• Must be a highly motivated team player who can thrive in a dynamic startup-like environment
• Must have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
• Strong communication and collaboration abilities

Benefits
• Hands-on experience working on real-world machine learning projects.
• Mentorship and guidance from experienced ML engineers and data scientists
• Opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative AI-powered solutions.
• Exposure to the latest tools, technologies, and best practices in the field
• Potential for a full-time position upon successful completion of the internship
